activity.role: President of the Governor's Council and Acting Governor
activity.notes: Robert Carter I was a planter and colonial administrator, not a hereditary ruler. Encyclopedia Virginia records him as president of the Council exercising the colony's executive authority between Hugh Drysdale and William Gooch.

sources.title: Governors of Virginia — Encyclopedia Virginia
sources.citation_text: Encyclopedia Virginia lists Robert Carter, president of the Council, as serving from 1 August 1726 to 11 September 1727.
